n827354eb00.headline: After Revolut, UK's Digital Bank Monzo May Be Entering Fast-Growing Buy Now Pay Later Market
n827354eb00.summary: Monzo, a UK-based digital banking platform, is considering entering the rapidly expanding Buy Now Pay Later market following Revolut.
n827354eb00.why: Entry into BNPL market could diversify Monzo's revenue streams and increase competition in fintech lending services.

n5d65d3b3ad.headline: BVB Lost Over 630 Million Lei in Capitalization Last Week
n5d65d3b3ad.summary: The Bucharest Stock Exchange lost 630.5 million lei in market capitalization last week, a 0.3% decline, with stock transaction value down 5.7%.
n5d65d3b3ad.why: Market capitalization changes reflect investor sentiment and liquidity conditions in Romania's equity market.
n5d65d3b3ad.why_moved: The decline in capitalization and transaction volume signals reduced investor confidence and liquidity in the Romanian market.

n7c8597f2dd.headline: Congress will debate this Monday the extension of the suspension of fiscal rules due to the pandemic
n7c8597f2dd.summary: Spain's Congress will debate on Monday an extension of the suspension of deficit and debt targets introduced because of the pandemic, following last year's endorsement for 2020.
n7c8597f2dd.why: Fiscal rules set limits on deficits and debt; suspending them lets governments spend more, which affects sovereign borrowing and bond markets.
